judgment.reasoning_summary: The goal is to find the minimum number of intersections formed by connecting any two of the n distinct points on the plane. Since each pair of points defines a unique line, and each line can intersect with every other line at most once, the minimum number of intersections is achieved when no three points are collinear. This results in a total of C(n, 2) = n(n-1)/2 intersections.
